shell_commands: /usr/bin/zsh -lc "pwd && sed -n '1,240p' ../ticket.md && if [ -f ../round-brief.md ]; then sed -n '1,260p' ../round-brief.md; fi && sed -n '1,280p' .lore/dod.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short --branch && git log --oneline -5 && sed -n '1,260p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts && sed -n '1,240p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts && sed -n '1,200p' .lore/test-commands.yml && sed -n '1,180p' specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md && sed -n '1,60p' CHANGELOG.md && rg -n \"specs/.+#|validated by|@spec|spec:\" src --glob '*.test.ts' | head -80"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '110,175p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts && sed -n '1,100p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.beforeSession.acceptance.test.ts && git show --stat --oneline HEAD && git show --format= --name-only HEAD && git diff origin/main -- specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md CHANGELOG.md .lore/dod.md src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,240p' scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs && rg -n \"specs/.*#[0-9]+|@spec|SPEC\" src scripts --glob '*.test.ts' --glob '*.mjs' | head -120 && git branch --show-current"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git diff -- src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts && timeout 300 npm test -- --runTestsByPath src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts -t 'runs onError then afterSession when it throws, and still rejects to the caller'"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "timeout 300 npm test -- --runTestsByPath src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts -t 'runs onError then afterSession when it throws, and still rejects to the caller'"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "npx prettier --write src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md .lore/dod.md && if [ -f scripts/spec-links/reanchor.mjs ]; then node scripts/spec-links/reanchor.mjs; fi && nl -ba src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts | sed -n '110,145p' && git diff --check && git diff --stat && git diff"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "nl -ba src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.beforeSession.acceptance.test.ts | sed -n '35,45p'; rg --files scripts | rg 'reanchor|repoint-spec'; git status --short"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md && git diff --check && git status --short && git add .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts && git commit -m "fix: handle beforeSession hook failures"'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git push origin HEAD && git fetch origin main && git merge --no-edit origin/main && git push origin HEAD && git status --short --branch'
